root: ^Sofia's posture shifts slightly, as if debating whether to speak. After a moment, she exhales and meets your gaze.

^I see you found my cabin. Her tone remains composed, but there’s a flicker of hesitation in her eyes. Yes, it’s mine. A leader doesn’t get much peace in a place like this. Even I need somewhere to clear my head.
^She crosses her arms. But I wasn’t the only one there that night.
^She hesitates, then exhales. Sheila came to see me. She wanted to talk in private, away from town. She seemed… tense. She didn’t say why, not at first.
^Sofia looks away for a moment, gathering her thoughts. I left before midnight. She was alive when I walked away. That’s the truth. Her voice hardens slightly, her grip tightening on her sleeve.
^I should’ve stayed. I should’ve made her come back with me. Her jaw clenches, but she forces herself to stay composed. But regretting the past won’t help us now. Focus on what’s in front of us.
